subject: The only reason Microsoft
author: gravy666
body: The only reason Microsoft created the Games for Windows Live program was to make online computer gaming cost money, outside of MMOs.  When they realized that PC gamers were never going to give in, Microsoft removed the fee.  Only downside is that we probably won't be getting many more Achievements from PC games anymore...

subject: Well it would have been nice
author: thewindowsfreak
body: Well it would have been nice if it was LIVE. :(

subject: Games for Windows

body:
PS3 seems to be CG's platform of choice so I guess they simply did not want to support Microsoft more than necessary since Live games is run by microsoft. Or maybe because EA already has the required infrastructure in place to download and buy the games?
